body.title: The team inside the site, on Mistral: seven roles on pipeline-demo (every role on mistral-small-2603)
body.story: The seven roles of "A website with a team inside" (Dinis Cruz, 19 November 2026), each doing its job on a real public site in the family, on Mistral models only. Nothing is pushed to the site: the edit is a proposal for its owner. Every role on mistral-small-2603, to compare with the tiered run.

body.request: Make the page that explains how to ask for a site clearer for a first-time visitor, check it, and offer its opening in Portuguese and French. Report back before anything goes live.

edit.after: The fields you must fill in are:
edit.reason: The heading is too vague and does not clearly indicate that these are the fields to be filled in.

suggestions.what: Add a clear heading hierarchy with H1, H2, and H3 tags
suggestions.why: The current layout lacks distinct headings, making it harder for first-time visitors to quickly grasp the structure and key sections of the page.

suggestions.what: Convert the 'Fields' section into a bulleted list with descriptions
suggestions.why: The tabular format for field rules is less readable than a structured list, which would improve clarity and scanning for visitors unfamiliar with the requirements.

suggestions.what: Separate the 'Groups' section into two distinct lists: one for the group name and another for examples
suggestions.why: The current combined list mixes group names with examples, which could confuse users trying to understand the available options.
